## ManyDoors AI — Property Management Software
- Product: ManyDoors AI (manydoorsai.com) — AI property management for multifamily operators
- Tagline: AI-powered property operations — maintenance triage, leasing, and resident communications
- Support: U.S.-based onboarding and on-call escalation; continuous platform updates
- Live demo host: https://www.macrorei.com/property-management

### ManyDoors public pages (index these)
- https://www.macrorei.com/property-management — Gateway home: ROI, NOI charts, video hero, Enter platform CTA
- https://www.macrorei.com/property-management/features/communications — AI resident communication (50–70% inquiry deflection)
- https://www.macrorei.com/property-management/features/leasing — Automated leasing, speed-to-lead, pre-screen, fraud audit
- https://www.macrorei.com/property-management/features/maintenance — AI maintenance triage, emergencies, self-help deflection
- https://www.macrorei.com/property-management/features/owner-portal — Owner portal, NOI reporting, PDF reports
- https://www.macrorei.com/property-management/features/us-support — U.S. support teams, continuous updates, compliance

### ManyDoors product modules (live demo behind Enter)
- Operations dashboard — deflection rate, time saved, leasing pipeline, open work orders
- AI resident communication — SMS + email inbox with property knowledge base
- Automated leasing — lead response, pre-screening, application audit
- AI maintenance triage — priority routing, on-call tech, self-help
- Owner portal — NOI MTD/YTD, budget variance, AI impact, owner PDF reports
- Knowledge base — per-property FAQs and policies powering AI answers
